question: Which of the following terms is associated with the 'Bharatnatyam' dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tillana.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

Key Points__**

 
• As a solo dance, Bharatnatyam leans heavily on the abhinaya or **mime aspect of dance – the nritya, **where the dancer expresses the Sahitya through movement and mime.
 
• It is in the adoration of the Supreme Being. 
 
• It is a vibrant dance performed to the accompaniment of musical syllables with a **few lines of Sahitya.**
 
• The finale of the piece is a series of well designed rhythmic lines reaching a climax.
 
• A Bharatnatyam performance ends with a** tillana which has its origin in the Tarana of Hindustani music.**
